faqs.a:
Section 304.1. General,
is hereby amended by adding a second paragraph after the exception to the first paragraph
               to read as follows:
"
304.1. General.
Any permit applicant intending to provide combustion, ventilation, and dilution air
                  by a method other than outdoor combustion air shall, at the time of permit application,
                  submit to the building official all calculations, drawings, and other information
                  necessary to demonstrate compliance with code provisions governing such alternate
                  method. In a case where the permit applicant has selected the all indoor combustion
                  air method, all such calculations and information shall be submitted on forms provided
                  by the building inspection division. No permit for work using a method other than
                  outdoor combustion air shall be issued until after the building official or designee
                  thereof has reviewed and approved all submitted documentation."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 9, 9-14-2020)
